name: Pitti Engineering Limited
summary: Pitti Engineering Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel engineering products in India and internationally. The company offers electrical steel laminations, stator and rotor cores, sub-assemblies for motor and generator cores, pole assemblies, die-cast rotors, high precision press tools, and machined casted and fabricated parts and forged shafts. Its products are used in hydro and thermal generation, wind energy, mining, cement, steel, sugar, construction, lift irrigation, freight rail, passenger rail, mass urban transport, e-mobility, appliances, medical equipment, oil and gas, and other industrial applications.
